Plot gains and losses of features over time

Source: R/AllGenerics.R, R/plotTurnover.R, R/zzz-mae.R
plotTurnover.Rd

plotTurnover() counts the features gained and lost between consecutive samples of each subject and draws them as bars spanning the interval between the samples.

Usage

plotTurnover(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SummarizedExperiment'
plotTurnover(
  x,
  time.col,
  group = NULL,
  assay.type = "counts",
  detection = 0,
  type = c("gainloss", "components"),
  level = c("subject", "group"),
  group.by = NULL,
  max.gap = NULL,
  ...
)

# S4 method for class 'MultiAssayExperiment'
plotTurnover(x, ..., experiment = 1L)

Arguments

x

a SummarizedExperiment object.

...

additional arguments passed to geom_rect.

time.col

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) that contains sampling times: numeric, Date, POSIXct or a factor of visits. Time differences, as in max.gap, are in days for Date and hours for POSIXct times.

group

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) that identifies subjects. If NULL, all samples form one series. (Default: NULL)

assay.type

Character scalar. Specifies the assay. (Default: "counts")

detection

Numeric scalar. A feature is present in a sample when its value is above this. (Default: 0)

type

Character scalar. Draws the numbers of features gained (up) and lost (down) ("gainloss"), or turnover as the share of features present in either sample that appeared and disappeared ("components"). (Default: "gainloss")

level

Character scalar. Draws one panel per subject ("subject") or averages the subjects of each group.by group at each time ("group"). (Default: "subject")

group.by

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) that groups subjects when level = "group". If NULL, all subjects form one group. (Default: NULL)

max.gap

Numeric scalar. Skips the intervals between consecutive samples of a subject that are further apart than this, in time.col units. For visits, NULL skips intervals across visits without a sample; otherwise NULL keeps all of them. (Default: NULL)

experiment

Character scalar or integer scalar. For a MultiAssayExperiment, the experiment to plot; its samples get the colData of x. (Default: 1L)

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

With type = "components", the bars stack appearance and disappearance; their sum is the total turnover of Hallett et al. (2016).

References

Hallett LM, et al. (2016). codyn: An R package of community dynamics metrics. Methods in Ecology and Evolution 7(10):1146-1151.

Examples

# 16 species in three bioreactors
data("minimalgut", package = "miaTime")
tse <- minimalgut
plotTurnover(tse, time.col = "Time.hr", group = "StudyIdentifier")


# Turnover components, averaged over the bioreactors
plotTurnover(tse, time.col = "Time.hr", group = "StudyIdentifier",
    type = "components", level = "group")
